plan.goal: Generate Thiessen (Voronoi) polygons from input point features using geovoronoi package, bounded by the convex hull to ensure no polygons are discarded
plan.notes: Use geovoronoi's voronoi_polygons_from_points function with the convex hull of input points as the boundary region to guarantee all Voronoi cells are bounded polygons. The input points asset has 5 features with CRS Krasovsky_1940_Transverse_Mercator. Preserve all original attribute fields (名称, Distance) in the output. Output CRS should match the input CRS.
